history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. This record covers the Baptist congregation presence in Thenzawl (CSV row 'Thenzawl Baptist Church'), Mizoram's state correction: CSV 'state' column wrongly held the town name; actual state is Mizoram. Baptist worship is well documented in Thenzawl: the Baptist Church of Mizoram (BCM) Thenzawl Pastor Bial includes about nine kohhran/fellowships (Bethlehem, Venghlun, Thenzawl, Kanaan, Shalom, Salem, New Jerusalem, Gosen and others), per the BCM Statistical Report 2023-24; listed congregations include Venghlun Baptist Church and BCM Thenzawl Bazar. However, the specific single building named 'Thenzawl Baptist Church' has no separate documented identity - it is a generic CSV entry for the town's Baptist (BCM) church presence. Coordinates are town-level (Thenzawl, approx. 23.2812, 92.77565); precise congregation location unverified. Media image is a representative Baptist church photo from the BCM's own website, NOT confirmed to be the Thenzawl congregation building. Christianity reached Mizoram through Welsh Baptist missionary work beginning in the 1890s, and Mizoram is now a predominantly Christian state.

name: Thenzawl Baptist Church
town_description: Thenzawl is a town in Serchhip district, Mizoram, on the Aizawl-Lunglei road. Known as Mizoram's weavers' town for its traditional Mizo handloom weaving, it is a predominantly Christian Mizo community town (PIN 796186). Most businesses stay closed on Sundays as residents attend church.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport, near Aizawl - the nearest airport to Thenzawl (road distance not verified).
travel.railway: No railway line in the area; nearest railhead is near Aizawl (verify).
travel.road: Thenzawl lies on the Aizawl-Lunglei road (NH-54 corridor); connected by bus and taxi from Aizawl and Serchhip.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday worship services typical; weekday hours not published (verify). Everything shuts down on Sundays in Mizoram.
